'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] strike a residential area in [[Orikhiv]], [[Zaporizhzhia Oblast]], killing seven [[civilian]]s and injuring 11 others, according to [[Governor of Zaporizhzhia Oblast|Governor]] Yuriy Malashko. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/four-civilians-killed-11-wounded-russia-strikes-zaporizhzhia-town-ukraine-2023-07-10/ (Reuters)]
**[[Russian military commissariats attacks]]
***Stanislav Rzhitsky, deputy chief in charge of military mobilization in the Russian city of [[Krasnodar]] and commander of the [[Russian Navy]] submarine [[Kilo-class submarine|B-265 ''Krasnodar'']], is shot dead near the city's sports complex. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jul/11/senior-russian-draft-officer-shot-dead-while-running-in-park (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-749527 (Reuters via ''The Jerusalem Post'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[European Union–United States relations]]
**The [[European Commission]] and the [[U.S. government]] sign a new [[data communication]] [[Multilateral treaty|agreement]] aimed at resolving [[Legal certainty|legal uncertainties]] that European and American companies face when transferring [[personal data]]. However, [[non-profit organization]] [[NOYB]] plans to [[Legal threat|challenge]] the agreement. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/eu-announces-new-us-data-transfer-pact-challenge-ahead-2023-07-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**[[Spain]]'s [[Maritime Safety and Rescue Society]] rescues 86 people from a [[pirogue]] off the [[Canary Islands]] after [[human rights defender]] [[Helena Maleno]] reports that three boats carrying around 300 people from [[Senegal]] have gone missing since June. [https://www.voanews.com/a/spain-rescues-86-people-near-canary-islands-but-scores-of-migrants-from-senegal-remain-missing-/7175561.html (AP via VOA)]
*Six people are killed and three others are reported missing after heavy rains trigger [[landslide]]s in [[Kyushu]] and [[Chūgoku region|Chūgoku]], [[Japan]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jul/11/heaviest-rain-ever-causes-deadly-floods-and-landslides-in-japan (''The Guardian'')]
*Two people are killed and six others are injured when a building catches fire in [[Leishan County]], [[Guizhou]], [[China]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/video/2023/jul/10/massive-fire-tears-through-buildings-in-chinas-guizhou-province-video (''The Guardian'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Effects of climate change]]
**The [[World Meteorological Organization]] reports that the Earth experienced its hottest week on [[List of weather records|record]] at the beginning of July, attributing the unprecedented temperatures to [[climate change]] and the early stages of [[El Niño]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/science-environment/20230710-last-week-the-hottest-worldwide-on-record-un (AFP via RFI)]
**In a study published in the [[medical journal]] ''[[Nature Medicine]]'', researchers from the [[CERCA Institute|Barcelona Centre for International Health Research]] and [[Inserm]] estimate that [[2022 European heat waves|Europe's record heat waves in 2022]] resulted in 61,672 deaths. [https://apnews.com/article/europe-spain-germany-heatwave-deaths-summer-2022-8e4d8b68d05405605cd2885abed83c74 (AP)]
*[[Volcanism of Iceland]]
**[[List of volcanic eruptions in Iceland#21st century|Icelandic volcano Litli-Hrútur]] begins erupting. [https://metro.co.uk/video/new-drone-footage-shows-lava-erupting-icelands-litli-hrutur-volcano-2977767/ (''Metro'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Enlargement of NATO]]
**[[Sweden–NATO relations]]
***[[Turkish president]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] agrees to send [[Sweden]]'s NATO accession protocol to the [[Grand National Assembly of Turkey|Grand National Assembly]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nato-turkey-sweden-vilnius-summit-erdogan-stoltenberg-21db7e9be05074d5b0f053b488974a23 (AP)]
*[[China–Solomon Islands relations]]
**[[China]] and the [[Solomon Islands]] sign a cooperation agreement between the [[People's Police (China)|People's Police]] and the [[Royal Solomon Islands Police Force]] during [[Prime Minister of Solomon Islands|Prime Minister]] [[Manasseh Sogavare]]'s [[official visit]] to [[Beijing]] in an effort to strengthen their "comprehensive [[strategic partnership]]". [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/china-solomon-islands-agree-strategic-partnership-2023-07-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[North Korea–United States relations]]
**[[North Korea]] threatens to [[List of aircraft shootdowns|shoot down]] any [[United States Armed Forces|U.S.]] [[reconnaissance aircraft]] breaching its [[airspace]] following U.S. plans to deploy a [[ballistic missile submarine]] near [[Korea]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20230710-north-korea-threatens-to-shoot-down-us-spy-planes-violating-its-airspace (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Iran and weapons of mass destruction]], [[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**The U.S. [[Director of National Intelligence#Office of the Director of National Intelligence|Office of the Director of National Intelligence]] says that [[Iran]] is not developing a [[nuclear weapon]]. However, it also warns that Iran has ramped up activities that could help develop one. [https://apnews.com/article/us-iran-nuclear-intelligence-b506d130e474c00f6bd653d3d5a8d31a (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[School attacks in China]]
**Six people, including three children, are killed and another person is injured in a [[mass stabbing]] at a [[kindergarten]] in [[Lianjiang, Guangdong|Lianjiang]], [[Guangdong]]. The suspect is detained by the police. [https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/3-kids-among-6-dead-in-stabbing-at-kindergarten-in-china-attacker-held-2404268-2023-07-10 (''India Today'')]
*[[Germans|German]] businessman Hans Peter Walter Mack, 62, suspected of running a [[Trafficking of children|child sex trafficking ring]] in [[Thailand]], is found [[Dismemberment|mutilated with a chainsaw]] in a freezer in [[Pattaya]]. [https://metro.co.uk/2023/07/11/thailand-suspected-child-sex-offender-found-dismembered-in-freezer-19108657/?ico=just-in_article_must-read (''Metro'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Dutch general election]]
**[[Prime Minister of the Netherlands|Prime Minister]] [[Mark Rutte]] announces his retirement from politics following the collapse of his [[Fourth Rutte cabinet|cabinet]]. [https://apnews.com/article/rutte-netherlands-migration-government-90b8716de33aabfad205874f69073b9c (AP)]
*[[2023 Uzbek presidential election]]
**[[Uzbek authorities]] announce that incumbent [[President of Uzbekistan|president]] [[Shavkat Mirziyoyev]] has been re-elected with 87.1% of the votes. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uzbek-leader-re-elected-seven-year-term-snap-election-2023-07-10/ (Reuters)]
